name: When should I consider a crawl space foundation over a slab for my addition?
description: Choose a crawl space over a slab for easier utility access, moisture protection, and suitability for sloped lots, despite potentially higher initial costs.

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a crawl space foundation over a slab for my addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a crawl space foundation over a slab for your addition if you need easier access for plumbing, electrical, or HVAC maintenance and future repairs. A crawl space also provides a buffer against moisture from the ground and can be advantageous on sloped lots where a slab might require extensive grading. While a crawl space may add to the initial construction cost compared to a basic slab, it offers significant practical benefits for long-term utility access and moisture management, which can save money on future maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a crawl space over a slab for easier utility access, moisture protection, and suitability for sloped lots, despite potentially higher initial costs.
